results.title: CENTCOM Claims Iran Unable to Finance Proxy Militia Amid US Naval Blockade
results.description: While the US claims its control over the Strait, earlier today, Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps stated that an “illegal supertanker” carrying more than two million barrels of crude oil was hit by a sea mine while attempting to pass through the “unauthorised” Strait of Hormuz.
